headline: Eurobattery Minerals CEO Arrested and Detained in Stockholm
summary: Roberto García, CEO and major shareholder of Eurobattery Minerals, has been detained by the Stockholm District Court over suspicions of seven counts of gross fraud and three counts of insider trading.
why: Executive misconduct and legal investigations involving listed mining exploration companies typically trigger trading halts and severe volatility for their shares.

impacts.name: Eurobattery Minerals
impacts.why: The arrest of the CEO on fraud and insider trading charges directly impacts investor confidence and trading status.
